title: Detection and Characterisation of Varicella Zoster Virus From Dermal Lesions of Chickenpox-infected Patients
brief_summary: This study is conducted in order to collect clinical samples from patients who are diagnosed of having chickenpox infection. The results of this study will provide basic scientific information about chickenpox disease.
raw_criteria: Pediatric patients who are diagnosed of having varicella and are presenting varicella dermal lesions.
